Voice of Voters — event collateral for YLAC India.

Standees and a stage backdrop for YLAC India's non-partisan youth voter-engagement forums around the 2019 elections — a raised tricolour fist, the Parliament dome over watercolour hills ("let's talk about the future of India"), and a banner of partners and young faces. Saffron, white and green.

Graphic & event design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·53.
